## Handlers that do **not** send HTTP to stored webhook URLs

Webhook CRUD handlers (`ListUserWebhooks`, `CreateUserWebhook`, `UpdateUserWebhook`, `DeleteUserWebhook`, `GetUserWebhookSigningSecret`) only read/write settings or validate URLs — they never call `webhook.Post` / `PostAsync`. No other package (`server/runner`, `server/router/mcp`, etc.) references webhook dispatch.
